entries.323491d59e6b1dc6: A reportable segment for new businesses to expand into areas other than the existing tenki.jp business, pursuing the dynamic pricing business. Dynamic pricing is based on technology that calculates optimal prices by combining market conditions, individual preferences, human flow data, location and geographic information, weather data, and more. According to the securities report, as a PoC (proof of concept) ahead of this business, it operates rental spaces in the Tokyo metropolitan area (a business transfer agreement for the rental space business was concluded in February 2024). Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥42,153 thousand (up 68.9% from the previous year), the smallest of the four reportable segments, and the segment loss was ¥31,521 thousand (compared with a loss of ¥23,631 thousand in the previous year).
entries.32da0c10d592281b: A reportable segment that temporarily holds solar power generation facilities in the secondary market (a market where facilities already in use are traded) and earns electricity sales revenue. The securities report states that revenue consists of electricity sales revenue (sales) and sponsor fees received from intermediary operators when a facility is sold to an end user (recorded as interest income under non-operating income). It was previously included in "Other Businesses," but because its share of sales increased, it became an independent reportable segment from the fiscal year ended February 2026 (prior-year figures are presented reclassified to the new segment classification). Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥133,289 thousand (up 88.3% from the previous year), and segment profit was ¥129,081 thousand (up 89.1% from the previous year); it is third in sales scale among the four reportable segments.

entries.833bf16a0b432eb1: A reportable segment that produces content for the regional revitalization project "Onsen Musume." It is run by Embound Co., Ltd., which became a subsidiary in May 2024 (a consolidated subsidiary in which the Company holds 100.0% of the voting rights), and began in the 12th fiscal period (fiscal year ended February 2025). Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥286,390 thousand (up 94.6% from the previous year), the second largest of the four reportable segments, but the segment recorded a loss of ¥115,604 thousand (compared with a loss of ¥75,048 thousand in the previous year). The securities report states that merchandise sales and events promoting the appeal of hot spring areas progressed smoothly against plan, but the segment posted a loss owing to factors including ¥51,204 thousand in development costs for the Pokakatsu app and ¥33,680 thousand in amortization of goodwill.

entries.a0f29d091170c055: A reportable segment that operates the weather forecast media "tenki.jp" and "tenki.jp Tozan Tenki" for mountain climbers as a joint business with the Japan Weather Association (a general incorporated foundation), and the category with the largest revenue from external customers among the 4 reportable segments. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥554,131 thousand (down 14.2% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥179,959 thousand (down 36.6% from the previous fiscal year). The securities report says that weather forecasts are provided to users free of charge, the main revenue is advertising revenue displayed on each page, and in the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from performance-based advertising accounted for more than 80% of this business's revenue. Advertising revenue is first paid to the Japan Weather Association, and the company receives an allocation at the revenue share rate set by contract (the company 49.5 : Japan Weather Association 50.5). The securities report says that PVs in the fiscal year ended February 2026 fell to 5.3 billion PV, 88.5% of the previous fiscal year, and gives as reasons a decrease in precipitation, the rise of AI search, and the effect of weather data displayed by search engines and browsers themselves.

entries.a45cb461b0f3cbd0: According to the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]], the group operates businesses connecting weather information with society, with the management philosophy “Making Future Plans Sunny.” The core business is the weather forecast media site “tenki.jp,” a joint business with the General Incorporated Foundation Japan Weather Association. The Japan Weather Association, which employs certified weather forecasters, mainly handles forecast data and content, while the company mainly handles site and app design, system operation and advertising operations, respectively. Most revenue comes from advertising on each page; after payment is first received by the Japan Weather Association, it is allocated to the company under the revenue-sharing ratio set in the contract (the company 49.5 : Japan Weather Association 50.5). In addition, the company has four [[term:segment|reportable segments]], covering content production for “Onsen Musume” (IP Production Business), electricity sales from temporarily holding solar power generation equipment (Solar Consulting Business), and technology development for dynamic pricing (Other Businesses).
